    """Find glass transition temperature using piecewise linear fitting."""
    # Sort by temperature
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(temperatures)
    T = temperatures[sorted_indices]
    rho = densities[sorted_indices]
    
    # Remove duplicates and average densities at same temperature
    unique_T = []
    unique_rho = []
    i = 0

            j += 1

        i = j
    
    T = np.array(unique_T)
    rho = np.array(unique_rho)
    
    if len(T) < 10:
        print(f"Warning: Only {len(T)} data points found")
        return None
    
    # Try different breakpoints to find best fit
    best_tg = None
    best_score = float('inf')

    T_min, T_max = T.min(), T.max()

            slope_high, intercept_high, r_high, _, _ = stats.linregress(T[mask_high], rho[mask_high])

            pred_low = slope_low * T[mask_low] + intercept_low
            pred_high = slope_high * T[mask_high] + intercept_high
            residuals = np.sum((rho[mask_low] - pred_low)**2) + np.sum((rho[mask_high] - pred_high)**2)
